jobs.description:
SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W) - Swatch Group

SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W)
Firmenbeschreibung
OMEGA ist eine prestigeträchtige globale Marke, die seit mehr als 170 Jahren nach höchster Qualität, äusserster Präzision und immer neuen Innovationen strebt. Unsere Uhren gehören zu den besten der Welt, sie sind das Ergebnis von Technologien, die führend in der Uhrenbranche sind und sich durch ein zeitloses Design auszeichnen.
Im Laufe unserer langen Geschichte haben wir Präzisionsrekorde aufgestellt, die Sportzeitnahme entscheidend geprägt und nach wie vor nehmen wir eine Vorreiterrolle in der hohen Uhrmacherkunst ein.
Als internationale Marke sind wir immer daran interessiert, zukünftige Kollegen kennenzulernen, die bereit sind, unsere Teams auf praktisch jedem Kontinent durch ihre Talente, ihre Ambitionen und ihre Inspiration zu unterstützen.
Stellenbeschreibung
Sie leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zum Erfolg der Boutique und zur Erreichung der Verkaufsziele
Sie generieren und pflegen den Kontakt mit unserer anspruchsvollen Kundschaft
Sie sind ein Botschafter unserer Marke und beraten unsere Kunden auf höchstem Niveau, inklusiv aller technischen Feinheiten unserer Uhren
Profil
Ähnliche Erfahrung im Luxussegment, idealerweise in der Uhren- und Schmuckbranche
Kontaktfreudige Verkäuferpersönlichkeit mit Initiative
Serviceorientierung auf hohem Niveau für unsere anspruchsvolle Kundschaft
Berufliche 
• Anforderungen
Gepflegtes, zuvorkommendes und tadelloses Auftreten
Ausgezeichneter Teamgeist, verfügbar und flexibel
Sprachkenntnisse
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch oder Französisch und Englisch (zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil)
Kontaktperson
Jean-Baptiste Haas
HR Business Partner
Arbeitsort
Bahnhofstrasse 48
8001 Zürich (Zurich)
Schweiz
Firmenadresse
Omega AG
Jakob-Stämpflistrasse 96
CH-2502 Biel

SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W) - Gruppo Swatch

SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W)
Descrizione della Società
OMEGA è un prestigioso marchio globale che da oltre 170 anni si impegna con la massima qualità, la massima precisione e sempre nuove innovazioni. I nostri orologi sono tra i migliori al mondo, sono il risultato di tecnologie che sono leader nell'industria orologiera e sono caratterizzati da un design senza tempo.
Nel corso della nostra lunga storia, abbiamo creato dischi di precisione, svolto un ruolo decisivo nel tempo sportivo e continuiamo a svolgere un ruolo di primo piano nell'alta orologeria.
Come marchio internazionale, siamo sempre interessati a conoscere i futuri colleghi che sono disposti a sostenere i nostri team in praticamente ogni continente attraverso i loro talenti, ambizioni e ispirazione.
Designazione
Essi danno un contributo attivo al successo della boutique e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita
Generi e mantieni il contatto con la nostra clientela esigente
Sei un ambasciatore del nostro marchio e consiglia ai nostri clienti al massimo livello, compresi tutti i dettagli tecnici dei nostri orologi
Profilo
Esperienza simile nel segmento di lusso, idealmente nel settore orologi e gioielli
Personalità del venditore con l'iniziativa
L'orientamento al servizio ad alto livello per i nostri clienti esigenti
Professionista
• Requisiti
Aspetto attento, accomodante e impeccabile
Eccellente spirito di squadra, disponibile e flessibile
Capacità linguistiche
Conoscenza molto buona in tedesco o francese e inglese (le lingue aggiuntive sono vantaggiose)

Jean-Baptiste Haas
HR Business Partner

SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W) - Swatch Group

SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W)
Company description
OMEGA is a prestigious global brand that has been striving for more than 170 years with the highest quality, the most outstanding precision and ever new innovations. Our watches are among the best in the world, they are the result of technologies that are leading in the watch industry and are characterized by a timeless design.
Over the course of our long history, we have set up precision records, played a decisive role in sporting time and we continue to play a leading role in high watchmaking.
As an international brand, we are always interested in getting to know future colleagues who are willing to support our teams on virtually every continent through their talents, ambitions and inspiration.
Description
They make an active contribution to the success of the boutique and to the achievement of the sales goals
You generate and maintain contact with our demanding clientele
You are an ambassador of our brand and advise our customers at the highest level, including all technical details of our watches
Profile
Similar experience in the luxury segment, ideally in the watch and jewelry industry
Contact-Friendly Seller Personality with Initiative
Service orientation at a high level for our demanding customers
Professional
• Requirements
Careful, accommodating and impeccable appearance
Excellent team spirit, available and flexible
Language skills
Very good knowledge in German or French and English (additional languages are advantageous)
Contact person
Jean-Baptiste Haas
HR Business Partner

Switzerland

Représentant des ventes - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W) - Swatch Group

REPRÉSENTANT DES VENTES - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZÜRICH (M/W)
Désignation de l'entreprise
OMEGA est une marque mondiale prestigieuse qui s'efforce depuis plus de 170 ans avec la plus haute qualité, la plus grande précision et de nouvelles innovations. Nos montres sont parmi les meilleures au monde, elles sont le résultat de technologies qui sont leader dans l'industrie horlogère et sont caractérisées par un design intemporel.
Au cours de notre longue histoire, nous avons établi des records de précision, joué un rôle décisif dans le temps sportif et nous continuons à jouer un rôle de premier plan dans la haute horlogerie.
En tant que marque internationale, nous sommes toujours intéressés à connaître de futurs collègues qui sont prêts à soutenir nos équipes sur pratiquement tous les continents grâce à leurs talents, ambitions et inspiration.
Désignation des marchandises
Ils contribuent activement au succès de la boutique et à la réalisation des objectifs de vente
Vous créez et maintenez le contact avec notre clientèle exigeante
Vous êtes un ambassadeur de notre marque et conseillez nos clients au plus haut niveau, y compris tous les détails techniques de nos montres
Profil
Expérience similaire dans le secteur du luxe, idéalement dans l'industrie de la montre et des bijoux
Contact-Amis Personnalité vendeur avec Initiative
Orientation de service à un niveau élevé pour nos clients exigeants
Professionnel
• Exigences
Aspect soigné, accommodant et impeccable
Excellent esprit d'équipe, disponible et flexible
Compétences linguistiques
Très bonne connaissance en allemand ou en français et en anglais (les langues supplémentaires sont avantageuses)
Personne à contacter
Jean-Baptiste Haas
Partenaire opérationnel RH
Lieu de travail
Gare 48
8001 Zürich (Zurich)
Suisse

Omega AG
Jakob-Stämpflistrasse 96
CH-2502 Biel

jobs.description:
Sales Advisor – Temporary Position (Sick Leave Cover) - Swatch Group

Sales Advisor – Temporary Position (Sick Leave Cover)
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
• We are looking for Sales Advisors to join one of our shops in Madrid on a temporary basis to cover two sick leave absences.
• Reporting to the Store Manager, the main functions of the Sales Advisor are:
• Customer Service
• To ensure a luxury selling ceremony
• To achieve and exceed individual Sales Goals
• To maintain Merchandising guidelines
• Maintenance of the Store
• Stock Control
• Other administrative tasks
• Profile
• Previous experience in retail or customer-facing roles is a plus
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Sales‑driven mindset and ability to work in a fast‑paced environment
• Availability to work during the full sick‑leave coverage period
• Team spirit and a proactive attitude
• Professional requirements
• You will be a communicative person, results and customer service oriented and you will have an eye for detail.
• Languages
• Conversation level of English.
• Knowledge in other language would be a plus
• Contact
• empleo@es.swatchgroup.com
• Job location
• PRECIADOS/GOYA/CASTELLANA
• 28013 MADRID (Madrid Province)
• Spain
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (España) S.A.
• Edificio C, Miniparc I

jobs.description:
Store Manager – Pop Up Ibiza - Swatch Group

Store Manager – Pop Up Ibiza
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
We are looking for a Store Manager to lead our seasonal pop‑up in Ibiza from June to September. If you bring strong retail expertise, a proactive mindset, and the ability to elevate both team performance and customer experience, this role offers an exciting summer challenge.
Key
• Responsibilities
Drive revenue growth, oversee daily operations, and lead the sales team with a hands‑on, people‑first approach.
Develop strategies and action plans to achieve sales targets through clientelling, exceptional service, events, partnerships, and traffic‑driving initiatives.
Ensure a consistent, high‑quality in‑store experience aligned with brand standards.
Think strategically and make decisions that elevate store performance.
Prioritize, plan, delegate, and manage administrative tasks while adapting to evolving business needs.
Maximize inventory efficiency and maintain strong cash‑control and loss‑prevention practices.
Profile
Previous experience as a Store Manager or Assistant Manager in retail.
Positive leadership, strong people skills, and the ability to inspire and motivate a team.
Passion for customer experience and creating meaningful interactions.
Analytical mindset, results orientation, and agile decision‑making.
Professional requirements
Flexibility, energy, and enthusiasm to be part of a special seasonal project.
Availability to work in rotating shifts.
Intermediate computer skills (Microsoft Office).
Languages
Conversation level of English.
Knowledge in other language would be a plus.
Contact
empleo@es.swatchgroup.com
